author: AuTSM
body:
Your minecraft in game name: AuTSM
Reason for being banned: Spawn Killing (3 day)
Reason I should be unbanned:
Take a look at my infractions - this was my first infraction. You can see from my PvP encounters that I killed 2 players max. I had no idea that this was classed as spawnkilling, It wasn't as if I was standing there critting people, I was running trying to  save myself,  and even if there was the chance that I may be spawnkilling, I'd expect atleast a verbal warn. I was clueless that I was spawnkilling and this being my first infraction, I think it should have been a kick (with you warning me in game first.)

replies.body:
Hello,

All the players were warned in that game before any punishments were dealt. The number kills is irrelevant as you were evidently attacking players as they spawned, which falls under the category of spawn killing. Please wait out the length of your temp-ban.
